title: Babydoll
lyrics:
[00:10.27]I can't move on, babydoll
[00:13.54]Waitin' on calls, flippin' through stations
[00:16.43]I'm outclassed and it's outrageous
[00:21.64]And I'll take it all, babydoll
[00:24.88]Whatever's been weighing you down
[00:34.60]Find me on Miami concrete
[00:36.75]Lookin' for somebody different 'cause my daddy was a pimp
[00:39.84]My mama had her issues but I miss her anyway, oh, babydoll
[00:46.08]Please don't call me for the wrong reasons
[00:48.89]We both know exactly what I'm thinkin'
[00:51.78]Weeks pass and I never grow tired
[00:53.88]'Cause I never said never, and I barely ever lie
[00:56.62]I'm on a road to an original place in outer space
[01:00.51]I didn't make it up, but you can't find it on a phone, or a globe
[01:04.81]And I can take you with me if you really wanna go, oh, babydoll
[01:10.69]I can't move on
[01:13.07]And I can't move on, babydoll
